Double-click to drink. Excessive [[alcohol]] consumption will result in [[Drunk|intoxication]]. }} [[Bottle of Vabbian Wine]] is an [[alcohol]]ic drink. When consumed, it will count towards attaining the [[Drunkard]] [[title]]. ==Acquisition== * [[Vabbi]] **[[The Kodash Bazaar]] *** From a [[Vabbi Trade Official]] for one [[Trade Contract]] ** [[Vehtendi Valley]] *** From [[Ahoj]] for 5 [[Sentient Spore]]s *** [[Jarimiya the Unmerciful]] [[drop]]s a single, randomly [[assign]]ed bottle each time it is killed. ===Farming=== Farming [[Sentient Spore]]s and trading them to Ahoj is the simplest way to farm this item, though it is also possible to use heroes to reach Jarimiya the Unmerciful's group with a farming build, then moving those heroes outside of compass range (when their names turn grey) so that the boss's guaranteed bottle drop always goes to the player. For Jarimiya farming, start from [[Yahnur Market]] with some Heroes and follow the southern route to the bridge just south of the boss group. Clear out the Kournans on the islet as well as the Heket group just to the west of Jarimiya (this might aggro the boss group, necessitating a quick retreat across the bridge). After this is done, use the Heroes to clear out most of Jarimiya's group, especially the healer, then send them back across the bridge and a bit up towards the Kournans' spot, while dragging Jarimiya to the spot the other Heket group was at to get the Heroes out of compass range. ==Collectors== {{:Lieutenant Thackeray/Collector2}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|27th December 2010 and 20th May 2013|Vehtendi Valley|1 [[Bottle of Vabbian Wine]]}} ==Notes== *Vabbian Wine provides one level of drunkenness, see [[Drunk#Intoxication_mechanics|the Drunk article]] for details. {{Alcohol nav}} [[Category:Items requested by Nicholas the Traveler]]
